Mark and a Seal

马克和一只海豹 · 175 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Mark used his pension to rent accommodation near the shore. He made annual visits to enjoy the vivid beauty in the depths of the clear sea.

2Once, with his underwater telescope and flashlight, Mark dived along the boundary between the steep reef and a seaweed conservation area. Suddenly, an awesome Antarctic seal with sharp teeth appeared in front of him. He was scared stiff. But soon, he was aware that he wasn’t the target of an attack. A shark had wounded the grey seal’s lip, and the tide kept turning it upside down. But it nudged Mark as if to urge him to help. So Mark abandoned any thought of fleeing. With the seal’s cooperation, Mark used a net to drag the seal to the shallow water. Without pausing, he treated its wound and settled it in a narrow cave by the seaside. Every time he brought it tasty fish, it would yell with delight and suck on his hand. Witnesses said the anecdote revealed a remarkable dimension of the relationship between humans and animals.

马克和一只海豹

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1马克用退休金在海边租了个住处。每年他都去那里，欣赏清澈海水深处生机勃勃的景色。

2一次，马克带着水下望远镜和手电筒，沿着陡峭礁石与海藻保护区的交界潜水。突然，一只牙齿锋利、让人敬畏的南极海豹出现在他面前。他顿时吓得浑身发僵，不过很快发现海豹并不想攻击他。这只灰海豹的嘴唇被鲨鱼咬出一道伤口，潮水一次又一次把它冲得肚皮朝上。它轻轻撞了撞马克，仿佛在催他帮忙。马克于是打消了逃走的念头。在海豹的配合下，他用网把它拖到浅水区，马上替它简单处理了伤口，再把它安置在海边一处狭窄的洞里。每次马克带来鲜美的鱼，海豹都会高兴地叫，还吮吸他的手。目击者说，这段经历让人看到了人与动物关系中奇妙的一面。
